html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqichli hisob. Avval har bir mijozning jami xaridi: GROUP BY customer_id va SUM(amount). Keyin shu jamilarning o'rtachasi. Ikkinchi bosqich birinchisining natijasi ustida ishlaydi, shuning uchun guruhlangan so'rovni FROM ichiga qo'yib, oddiy jadval kabi o'qiymiz.

Yechim

SELECT customer_id, total
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t
WHERE total > (
  SELECT AVG(total)
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
  ) x
)

Namunada jamilar 150 000, 40 000 va 200 000, ularning o'rtachasi 130 000. Natijada 1- va 3-mijoz qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Buyurtmalar o'rtachasi bilan mijozlar jamilarining o'rtachasi bir narsa emas. AVG(amount) beshta buyurtmani o'rtachalaydi va namunada 78 000 chiqadi. Bu chegaradan uchala mijoz ham o'tib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(amount) > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders)

Shart "yuqori", shuning uchun >= ham xato: yolg'iz mijoz o'rtachaning o'zi va natija bo'sh bo'lishi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Bir xil hosila jadvalni ikki marta yozmaslik uchun unga WITH bilan nom bering:

WITH t AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, total
FROM t
WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM t)
